//: Azure Static Web Apps configuration for the GCDC Knowledge Mapping Page.
Effect: every page requires a signed-in GCDC work account (Microsoft Entra ID).
Anonymous visitors are redirected to the Microsoft sign-in page.
See docs/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT.md for the setup steps.

routes.//: Disable the built-in GitHub identity provider — work accounts only.
Everything on the site requires an authenticated user.

401.//: Send anonymous visitors straight to Entra ID sign-in (usually silent SSO).

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.sharepoint.com; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
